    # RoomieOS implementation plan
    
    **Last updated:** 24 November 2026
    
    **Status:** Milestone 5 complete; shared UI refresh implemented and verified; ready for component review. No deployment performed.
    
    **Current milestone:** UI refresh complete — awaiting user visual feedback.
    
    **Next milestone:** Milestone 6 — release verification and submission deliverables.
    
    **Delivery target:** Thursday, 26 November 2026; Friday, 27 November is the submission/fix buffer.
    
    ## 1. Purpose, authority and decisions
    
    Build a polished Next.js client-side prototype for ENTI 407. `docs/PRD.md` is authoritative for behavior; `docs/DESIGN.md` is authoritative for UI/UX. This document records approved architecture, sequencing and actual progress. It does not override those requirements.
    
    At plan approval, the repository contained documentation and a README, with no application scaffold. The foundation, household setup/persistence, chores, expenses, agreements and integrated dashboard are now implemented; see the progress record below for verification. Update this record after each working slice: check only completed work, record actual verification, and keep the current/next milestone accurate. Surface conflicts or new scope for user review rather than inventing requirements.
    
    ### Resolved requirements and defaults
    
    - **Approved Milestone 2 expansion:** The user raised the active-roommate limit from 5 to 20 and requested more avatar choices. The current limit is **2–20 active roommates**, with 40 named/grouped emoji presets plus initials. PRD and DESIGN version 1.1 now reflect this explicit user-approved change from the original 2–5 limit. Existing saved avatar values and `schemaVersion: 1` remain compatible.
    - **Backend conflict resolved:** The user selected the approved local-only scope. Use Next.js App Router without backend API routes, Server Actions, authentication or a database. Household operations run in the browser.
    - **History ordering:** Preserve completion events in append order; display newest first, as DESIGN specifies.
    - **Archived-member edge cases:** Historical records remain viewable and editable without losing member references. Before reopening an expense involving archived members, require their restoration. Before reopening a chore assigned to an archived member, require reassignment to an active member. Rotation can directly select the next active member.
    - **Design contrast:** Preserve the visual palette, but use sufficiently dark text variants where muted tokens fail contrast requirements.
    - **Priority:** All PRD must-haves remain MVP requirements. Defer photo uploads, drag-and-drop and decorative animation.
    
    ## 2. Architecture and state
    "use client";
    import {
      ToggleGroup,
      ToggleGroupItem,
    } from "@/components/ui/primitives/toggle-group";
    
    import { useState } from "react";
    import { CheckSquare, Columns3, List, Plus } from "lucide-react";
    import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
    import { EmptyState } from "@/components/ui/empty-state";
    import { MemberAvatar } from "@/components/ui/member-avatar";
    import { PageHeader } from "@/components/ui/page-header";
    import { SelectField, selectOptions } from "@/components/ui/select-field";
    import { StatusPill } from "@/components/ui/status-pill";
    import { choreStatuses, choreStatusLabels, isOverdue } from "@/domain/chores";
    import { displayDate } from "@/domain/dates";
    import type { Chore, ChoreStatus } from "@/domain/types";
    import { useReadyHousehold } from "@/state/household-provider";
    import { useToday } from "@/state/use-today";
    import { ChoreForm } from "./chore-form";
    import { ChoreDetails } from "./chore-details";
    
    export function ChoresScreen() {
      const { state, store, conflict } = useReadyHousehold();
      const today = useToday();
      const [view, setView] = useState<"list" | "board">("board");
      const [status, setStatus] = useState("all");
      const [assigneeId, setAssigneeId] = useState("all");
      const [creating, setCreating] = useState(false);
      const [selectedId, setSelectedId] = useState<string | null>(null);
      const selected = state.chores.find((chore) => chore.id === selectedId);
      const chores = state.chores.filter(
        (chore) =>
          (status === "all" || chore.status === status) &&
          (assigneeId === "all" || chore.assigneeId === assigneeId),
      );
      const members = [...state.members].sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order);
      function newChore() {
        store.dismissFeedback();
        setCreating(true);
      }
      function openChore(chore: Chore) {
        store.dismissFeedback();
        setSelectedId(chore.id);
      }
      function memberLabel(chore: Chore) {
        const member = members.find((item) => item.id === chore.assigneeId)!;
        return (
          <span className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2">
            <MemberAvatar
              name={member.name}
              icon={member.avatar.kind === "icon" ? member.avatar.value : undefined}
            />
            <span className="min-w-0 break-words text-sm">
              {member.name}
              {!member.active && " (archived)"}
            </span>
          </span>
        );
      }
      function statusControl(chore: Chore, suffix: string) {
        return (
          <div className="min-w-0 space-y-2">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <StatusPill status={chore.status} />
              {isOverdue(chore, today) && (
                <span className="text-xs font-medium text-danger">Overdue</span>
              )}
            </div>
            <SelectField
              id={`${suffix}-${chore.id}-status`}
              label="Change status"
              aria-label={`Change status for ${chore.title}`}
              value={chore.status}
              disabled={conflict}
              onValueChange={(value) =>
                store.dispatch(
                  {
                    type: "set-chore-status",
                    id: chore.id,
                    status: value as ChoreStatus,
                  },
                  "Chore status updated.",
                )
              }
              options={selectOptions(
                choreStatuses.map((value) => ({
                  value: value,
                  label: <>{choreStatusLabels[value]}</>,
                })),
              )}
            />
          </div>
        );
      }
      return (
        <>
          <PageHeader
            title="Chores"
            description="A little clarity for the everyday things."
            icon={<CheckSquare className="size-6" />}
            action={
              <Button id="new-chore" onClick={newChore} disabled={conflict}>
                <Plus aria-hidden="true" className="size-4" />
                New chore
              </Button>
            }
          />
          <div className="mb-6 flex flex-wrap items-end gap-4">
            <ToggleGroup
              value={[view]}
              onValueChange={(values) => {
                if (values[0] === "list" || values[0] === "board")
                  setView(values[0]);
              }}
              aria-label="Chore view"
              className="flex self-end rounded-[7px] border border-line bg-subtle p-1"
            >
              <ToggleGroupItem value="list" className="min-h-11 px-4">
                <List aria-hidden="true" className="size-4" />
                List
              </ToggleGroupItem>
              <ToggleGroupItem value="board" className="min-h-11 px-4">
                <Columns3 aria-hidden="true" className="size-4" />
                Board
              </ToggleGroupItem>
            </ToggleGroup>
            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 basis-40">
              <SelectField
                id="chore-status-filter"
                label="Filter by status"
                value={status}
                onValueChange={(value) => setStatus(value)}
                options={selectOptions(
                  { value: "all", label: <>All statuses</> },
                  choreStatuses.map((value) => ({
                    value: value,
                    label: <>{choreStatusLabels[value]}</>,
                  })),
                )}
              />
            </div>
            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 basis-44">
              <SelectField
                id="chore-member-filter"
                label="Filter by roommate"
                value={assigneeId}
                onValueChange={(value) => setAssigneeId(value)}
                options={selectOptions(
                  { value: "all", label: <>All roommates</> },
                  members
                    .filter(
                      (member) =>
                        member.active ||
                        state.chores.some(
                          (chore) => chore.assigneeId === member.id,
                        ),
                    )
                    .map((member) => ({
                      value: member.id,
                      label: (
                        <>
                          {member.name}
                          {!member.active && " (archived)"}
                        </>
                      ),
                    })),
                )}
              />
            </div>
          </div>
          {state.chores.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState
              icon={<CheckSquare className="size-6" />}
              title="Nothing on the chore board"
              action={
                <Button disabled={conflict} onClick={newChore}>
                  Add a chore
                </Button>
              }
            >
              <p>Add your first chore to get started.</p>
            </EmptyState>
          ) : (
            <>
              <p role="status" className="mb-4 text-sm text-muted">
                {chores.length} {chores.length === 1 ? "chore" : "chores"}
                {status !== "all" || assigneeId !== "all"
                  ? " match your filters"
                  : " in your household"}
                .
              </p>
              {chores.length === 0 ? (
                <EmptyState
                  icon={<CheckSquare className="size-6" />}
                  title="No matching chores"
                  action={
                    <Button
                      variant="secondary"
                      onClick={() => {
                        setStatus("all");
                        setAssigneeId("all");
                      }}
                    >
                      Clear filters
                    </Button>
                  }
                >
                  <p>Try a different status or roommate.</p>
                </EmptyState>
              ) : view === "list" ? (
                <>
                  <div className="hidden rounded-[10px] border border-line md:block">
                    <table className="w-full table-fixed text-left text-sm">
                      <caption className="sr-only">Household chores</caption>
                      <thead className="border-b border-line bg-subtle text-muted">
                        <tr>
                          {["Chore", "Assigned to", "Due date", "Status"].map(
                            (label) => (
                              <th
                                key={label}
                                scope="col"
                                className="p-4 font-medium"
                              >
                                {label}
                              </th>
                            ),
                          )}
                        </tr>
                      </thead>
                      <tbody className="divide-y divide-line">
                        {chores.map((chore) => (
                          <tr key={chore.id}>
                            <td className="p-4 align-top">
                              <Button
                                variant="ghost"
                                onClick={() => openChore(chore)}
                                className="h-auto min-w-0 whitespace-normal justify-start px-0 hover:bg-transparent min-h-11 max-w-full rounded text-left font-semibold text-accent underline-offset-4 hover:underline [overflow-wrap:anywhere]"
                              >
                                {chore.title}
                              </Button>
                            </td>
                            <td className="p-4 align-top">{memberLabel(chore)}</td>
                            <td className="p-4 align-top">
                              <time dateTime={chore.dueDate}>
                                {displayDate(chore.dueDate)}
                              </time>
                            </td>
                            <td className="p-4 align-top">
                              {statusControl(chore, "table")}
                            </td>
                          </tr>
                        ))}
                      </tbody>
                    </table>
                  </div>
                  <ul aria-label="Household chores" className="space-y-3 md:hidden">
                    {chores.map((chore) => (
                      <li
                        key={chore.id}
                        className="space-y-4 rounded-[10px] border border-line p-4"
                      >
                        <Button
                          variant="ghost"
                          onClick={() => openChore(chore)}
                          className="h-auto min-w-0 whitespace-normal justify-start px-0 hover:bg-transparent min-h-11 max-w-full rounded text-left font-semibold text-accent [overflow-wrap:anywhere]"
                        >
                          {chore.title}
                        </Button>
                        {memberLabel(chore)}
                        <p className="text-sm text-muted">
                          Due {displayDate(chore.dueDate)}
                        </p>
                        {statusControl(chore, "card")}
                      </li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                </>
              ) : (
                <div
                  role="region"
                  aria-label="Chore board"
                  tabIndex={0}
                  className="max-w-full overflow-x-auto rounded-[10px] pb-3"
                >
                  <div className="grid min-w-[870px] grid-cols-3 items-start gap-4">
                    {choreStatuses.map((column) => {
                      const items = chores.filter(
                        (chore) => chore.status === column,
                      );
                      return (
                        <section
                          key={column}
                          aria-label={`${choreStatusLabels[column]} chores`}
                          className="min-w-0 rounded-[10px] border border-line bg-subtle p-3"
                        >
                          <h2 className="mb-3 flex items-center justify-between gap-2 px-1 text-sm font-semibold">
                            {choreStatusLabels[column]}
                            <span className="rounded bg-page px-2 py-1 text-xs text-muted">
                              {items.length}
                            </span>
                          </h2>
                          <ul className="space-y-3">
                            {items.map((chore) => (
                              <li
                                key={chore.id}
                                className="space-y-3 rounded-[7px] border border-line bg-page p-4"
                              >
                                <Button
                                  variant="ghost"
                                  className="h-auto min-w-0 whitespace-normal justify-start px-0 hover:bg-transparent min-h-11 max-w-full rounded text-left font-semibold text-accent [overflow-wrap:anywhere]"
                                  onClick={() => openChore(chore)}
                                >
                                  {chore.title}
                                </Button>
                                {memberLabel(chore)}
                                <p className="text-sm text-muted">
                                  Due {displayDate(chore.dueDate)}
                                </p>
                                {chore.notes && (
                                  <p className="truncate text-sm text-muted">
                                    {chore.notes}
                                  </p>
                                )}
                                {statusControl(chore, "board")}
                              </li>
                            ))}
                          </ul>
                          {!items.length && (
                            <p className="px-1 py-5 text-sm text-muted">
                              No {column} chores.
                            </p>
                          )}
                        </section>
                      );
                    })}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </>
          )}
          {creating && (
            <ChoreForm chore={null} onClose={() => setCreating(false)} />
          )}
          {selected && (
            <ChoreDetails
              key={selected.id}
              chore={selected}
              today={today}
              onClose={() => setSelectedId(null)}
              onDeleted={() => {
                setSelectedId(null);
                requestAnimationFrame(() =>
                  document.getElementById("new-chore")?.focus(),
                );
              }}
            />
          )}
        </>
      );
    }

    ---
    title: Server and Client Components
    description: Learn how you can use React Server and Client Components to render parts of your application on the server or the client.
    related:
      title: Next Steps
      description: Learn more about the APIs mentioned in this page.
      links:
        - app/api-reference/directives/use-client
        - app/guides/server-and-client-boundary
    ---
    
    By default, layouts and pages are [Server Components](https://react.dev/reference/rsc/server-components), which lets you fetch data and render parts of your UI on the server, optionally cache the result, and stream it to the client. When you need interactivity or browser APIs, you can use [Client Components](https://react.dev/reference/rsc/use-client) to layer in functionality.
    
    This page explains how Server and Client Components work in Next.js and when to use them, with examples of how to compose them together in your application.
    
    > **Good to know:** For an explanation of where each component type runs and how the boundary works, see [The Server and Client Boundary](/docs/app/guides/server-and-client-boundary).
    
    ## When to use Server and Client Components?
    
    The client and server environments have different capabilities. Server and Client Components allow you to run logic in each environment depending on your use case.
    
    Use **Client Components** when you need:
    
    - [State](https://react.dev/learn/managing-state) and [event handlers](https://react.dev/learn/responding-to-events). E.g. `onClick`, `onChange`.
    - [Lifecycle logic](https://react.dev/learn/lifecycle-of-reactive-effects). E.g. `useEffect`.
    - Browser-only APIs. E.g. `localStorage`, `window`, `navigator.geolocation`, etc.
    - [Custom hooks](https://react.dev/learn/reusing-logic-with-custom-hooks).
    
    Use **Server Components** when you need:
    
    - Fetch data from databases or APIs close to the source.
    - Use API keys, tokens, and other secrets without exposing them to the client.
    - Reduce the amount of JavaScript sent to the browser.
    - Improve the [First Contentful Paint (FCP)](https://web.dev/fcp/), and stream content progressively to the client.
    
    For example, the `<Page>` component is a Server Component that fetches data about a post, and passes it as props to the `<LikeButton>` which handles client-side interactivity.
    
    ```tsx filename="app/[id]/page.tsx" highlight={1,17} switcher

    }) {
      const { id } = await params
      const post = await getPost(id)
    
      return (

            <h1>{post.title}</h1>
            {/* ... */}
            <LikeButton likes={post.likes} />

    async function seed(page: Page, state = createSampleHousehold(new Date())) {
      await page.addInitScript((value) => {
        if (localStorage.getItem("roomieos:v1") === null)
          localStorage.setItem("roomieos:v1", JSON.stringify(value));
      }, state);
      await page.goto("/chores/");
      await expect(page.getByRole("heading", { level: 1 })).toHaveText("Chores");
    }
    async function saved(page: Page): Promise<AppState> {
      return page.evaluate(() => JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("roomieos:v1")!));
    }
    function titleButton(page: Page, title: string) {
      return page
        .getByRole("button", { name: title, exact: true })
        .filter({ visible: true });
    }
    async function noOverflow(page: Page) {
      expect(
        await page.evaluate(
          () => document.documentElement.scrollWidth > innerWidth,
        ),
      ).toBe(false);
    }

    type OptionInput = SelectOption | false | null | undefined | OptionInput[];
    export function selectOptions(...inputs: OptionInput[]): SelectOption[] {

        Array.isArray(input) ? selectOptions(...input) : input ? [input] : [],

    function text(node: ReactNode): string {
      if (typeof node === "string" || typeof node === "number") return String(node);
      if (Array.isArray(node)) return node.map(text).join("");
      if (isValidElement<{ children?: ReactNode }>(node))
        return text(node.props.children);
      return "";
    }

        if (pointer.current?.started) finish();

      function keyboard(event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLButtonElement>, chore: Chore) {
        if (disabled) return;
        const current = dragRef.current;
        if (!current && (event.key === " " || event.key === "Enter")) {
          event.preventDefault();
          update({
            id: chore.id,
            target: chore.status,
            mode: "keyboard",
            x: 0,
            y: 0,
          });
          setAnnouncement(
            `${chore.title} picked up. Use Left and Right to choose a column; Space or Enter to drop; Escape to cancel.`,
          );
          return;
        }
        if (!current || current.mode !== "keyboard" || current.id !== chore.id)
          return;
        if (event.key === " " || event.key === "Enter") {
          event.preventDefault();
          finish();
        } else if (event.key === "ArrowRight" || event.key === "ArrowLeft") {
          event.preventDefault();
          const index = choreStatuses.indexOf(current.target ?? chore.status);
          const target =
            choreStatuses[
              Math.max(
                0,
                Math.min(
                  choreStatuses.length - 1,
                  index + (event.key === "ArrowRight" ? 1 : -1),
                ),
              )
            ];
          update({ ...current, target });
          board.current
            ?.querySelector(`[data-chore-column="${target}"]`)
            ?.scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest", inline: "nearest" });
          setAnnouncement(
            `Move to ${choreStatusLabels[target]}. Press Space or Enter to drop.`,
          );
        }
      }

        const original = Storage.prototype.setItem;
        Storage.prototype.setItem = function (key, value) {
          if (
            key === "roomieos:v1" &&
            sessionStorage.getItem("fail-chore-save") === "yes"

    export function AgreementForm({

      onClose: () => void;

        title: agreement?.title ?? "",
        details: agreement?.details ?? "",
      });
      const [errors, setErrors] = useState<
        Partial<Record<keyof AgreementDraft, string>>
      >({});
      const [saveError, setSaveError] = useState<string>();
      function change(field: keyof AgreementDraft, value: string) {
        setDraft({ ...draft, [field]: value });
        setErrors({ ...errors, [field]: undefined });
        setSaveError(undefined);
      }
      function submit(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
        event.preventDefault();
        const parsed = agreementDraftSchema.safeParse({
          ...draft,
          title: draft.title.trim(),
        });

          const next: typeof errors = {};
          for (const issue of parsed.error.issues)
            next[issue.path[0] as keyof AgreementDraft] =
              issue.path[0] === "title"
                ? "Enter a title (1–100 characters)."
                : "Keep details to 1000 characters or fewer.";
          setErrors(next);
          focusInvalid(event.currentTarget);
          return;

            : { type: "add-agreement", agreement: parsed.data },
          agreement ? "Agreement updated." : "Agreement saved.",
        );
        if (result.ok) onClose();
        else setSaveError(result.error);

          title={agreement ? "Edit agreement" : "New agreement"}
          onClose={onClose}
        >
          <form noValidate onSubmit={submit} className="space-y-5">
            <FormField
              id="agreement-title"
              label="Title"
              required
              maxLength={100}
              value={draft.title}
              onChange={(event) => change("title", event.target.value)}
              error={errors.title}
            />
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <label
                htmlFor="agreement-details"
                className="block text-sm font-medium"
              >
                Details (optional)
              </label>
    "use client";
    import { useRef, type ReactNode } from "react";
    import { X } from "lucide-react";
    import { Button } from "./button";
    import { InlineNotice } from "./inline-notice";
    import * as D from "./primitives/dialog";
    import * as A from "./primitives/alert-dialog";
    import * as S from "./primitives/sheet";
    type DialogProps = {
      open: boolean;
      onClose: () => void;
      title: string;
      description?: string;
      children: ReactNode;
      variant?: "modal" | "drawer";
      id?: string;
      size?: "default" | "wide";
    };
    export function Dialog({
      open,
      onClose,
      title,
      description,
      children,
      variant = "modal",
      id,
      size = "default",
    }: DialogProps) {
      const trigger = useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null);
      const capture = () => {
        trigger.current =
          document.activeElement instanceof HTMLElement
            ? document.activeElement
            : null;
        return true;
      };
      const restore = () => {
        if (trigger.current?.isConnected) {
          trigger.current.focus();
          return false;
        }
        return true;
      };
      if (variant === "drawer")
        return (
          <S.Sheet
            open={open}
            onOpenChange={(v) => {
              if (!v) onClose();
            }}
          >
            <S.SheetContent
              id={id}
              side="left"
              className="w-80 max-w-[calc(100%-2rem)] overflow-y-auto"
              initialFocus={capture}
              finalFocus={restore}
            >
              <S.SheetHeader>
                <S.SheetTitle>{title}</S.SheetTitle>
                {description && (
                  <S.SheetDescription>{description}</S.SheetDescription>
                )}
              </S.SheetHeader>
              <div className="p-5">{children}</div>
            </S.SheetContent>
          </S.Sheet>
        );
      return (
        <D.Dialog
          open={open}
          onOpenChange={(v) => {
            if (!v) onClose();
          }}
        >
          <D.DialogContent
            id={id}
            showCloseButton={false}
            initialFocus={capture}
            finalFocus={restore}
            className={`flex max-h-[calc(100dvh-2rem)] w-[calc(100%-2rem)] flex-col gap-0 overflow-hidden p-0 ${size === "wide" ? "sm:max-w-2xl" : "sm:max-w-lg"}`}
          >
            <D.DialogHeader className="shrink-0 flex-row items-center justify-between border-b border-line px-5 py-3">
              <D.DialogTitle className="min-w-0 break-words text-lg font-semibold">
                {title}
              </D.DialogTitle>
              <Button
                size="icon"
            >
              {state.agreements.map((agreement) => (
                <li key={agreement.id} className="py-6">
                  <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                    <div className="min-w-0">
                      <h2 className="break-words text-lg font-semibold">
                        {agreement.title}
                      </h2>
                      {agreement.details && (
                        <p className="mt-3 whitespace-pre-wrap break-words text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted">
                          {agreement.details}
                        </p>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <AgreementActions
                      agreement={agreement}
                      disabled={conflict}
                      onEdit={() => {
                        store.dismissFeedback();
                        setEditor(agreement);
                      }}
                      onDelete={() => {
                        store.dismissFeedback();
                        setError(undefined);
                        setDeleting(agreement);
                      }}
                    />
                  </div>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          ) : (
            <EmptyState
              icon={<BookOpen className="size-6" />}
              title="Set the ground rules"
              action={
                <Button disabled={conflict} onClick={create}>
                  Add your first agreement
                </Button>
              }
            >
              <p>
                Add a few house agreements to keep expectations clear. Quiet hours
                or guest etiquette can be a good place to start.
              </p>
            </EmptyState>
          )}
          {editor && (
            <AgreementForm
              key={editor === "new" ? "new" : editor.id}
              agreement={editor === "new" ? undefined : editor}
              onClose={() => setEditor(null)}
            />
          )}
          <ConfirmDialog
            open={Boolean(deleting)}
            title="Delete agreement?"
            description={`Permanently delete “${deleting?.title ?? "this agreement"}”? This cannot be undone.`}
            confirmLabel="Delete agreement"
            destructive
            error={error}
            onClose={() => setDeleting(null)}
            onConfirm={() => {
              if (!deleting) return;
              const result = store.dispatch(
                { type: "delete-agreement", id: deleting.id },
                "Agreement deleted.",
              );
              if (result.ok) {
                setDeleting(null);
                requestAnimationFrame(() =>
                  document.getElementById("new-agreement")?.focus(),
                );
              } else setError(result.error);
            }}
          />
        </>
      );
    }

Highlight the destination column, support keyboard pickup/arrows/drop/Escape, and retain functional status selectors. Keep ordering within a column unchanged.

    > **Good to know:** For an explanation of where each component type runs and how the boundary works, see [The Server and Client Boundary](/docs/app/guides/server-and-client-boundary).
    
    ## When to use Server and Client Components?
    
    The client and server environments have different capabilities. Server and Client Components allow you to run logic in each environment depending on your use case.
    
    Use **Client Components** when you need:
    
    - [State](https://react.dev/learn/managing-state) and [event handlers](https://react.dev/learn/responding-to-events). E.g. `onClick`, `onChange`.
    - [Lifecycle logic](https://react.dev/learn/lifecycle-of-reactive-effects). E.g. `useEffect`.
    - Browser-only APIs. E.g. `localStorage`, `window`, `navigator.geolocation`, etc.
    - [Custom hooks](https://react.dev/learn/reusing-logic-with-custom-hooks).
    
    Use **Server Components** when you need:
    
    - Fetch data from databases or APIs close to the source.
    - Use API keys, tokens, and other secrets without exposing them to the client.
    - Reduce the amount of JavaScript sent to the browser.
    - Improve the [First Contentful Paint (FCP)](https://web.dev/fcp/), and stream content progressively to the client.
    
    For example, the `<Page>` component is a Server Component that fetches data about a post, and passes it as props to the `<LikeButton>` which handles client-side interactivity.

    # RoomieOS — Product Requirements Document
    
    **Version:** 1.1 · **Project:** ENTI 407 Creation Project · **Target:** Friday, 27 November 2026
    **Product type:** Interactive, client-side prototype (not a deployed multi-user service)
    **Status:** Approved product decisions; implementation-ready
    
    **Amended 23 November 2026:** User-approved expansion to 2–20 active roommates and 40 named, grouped preset avatar icons plus initials. Existing local data stays compatible with schema version 1.
    
    ## 1. Product summary
    
    **Tagline:** Your shared home, organized.
    
    RoomieOS is a lightweight household workspace for **university students living with roommates in apartments or residence units**. It combines household chores, shared expenses and house agreements in one understandable interface. A roommate chooses their profile from a switcher and can see their responsibilities alongside household-wide information.
    
    **Core problem:** Shared households coordinate through fragmented group chats, memory and spreadsheets. Tasks get forgotten, purchases are hard to split, and agreed expectations are difficult to find.
    
    **Value proposition:** One place to see who is doing what, who owes whom, and what the household agreed to—without requiring a complicated setup.
    
    18:Chores support create/edit/delete, List and Board views (Board opens by default), roommate/status filters, completion history and manual rotation with a confirmed due date. Click a chore title for details and actions. Completing a chore records the current demo perspective; reopening and rotating preserve its history.

    # RoomieOS implementation plan
    
    **Last updated:** 24 November 2026
    
    **Status:** Board-only chores and status tags implemented and verified. No deployment performed.
    
    **Current milestone:** Component review — board-only chores and status tags complete.
    
    **Next milestone:** Milestone 6 — release verification and submission deliverables.
    
    **Delivery target:** Thursday, 26 November 2026; Friday, 27 November is the submission/fix buffer.
    
    ## 1. Purpose, authority and decisions
    
    Build a polished Next.js client-side prototype for ENTI 407. `docs/PRD.md` is authoritative for behavior; `docs/DESIGN.md` is authoritative for UI/UX. This document records approved architecture, sequencing and actual progress. It does not override those requirements.
    
    At plan approval, the repository contained documentation and a README, with no application scaffold. The foundation, household setup/persistence, chores, expenses, agreements and integrated dashboard are now implemented; see the progress record below for verification. Update this record after each working slice: check only completed work, record actual verification, and keep the current/next milestone accurate. Surface conflicts or new scope for user review rather than inventing requirements.
    
    ### Resolved requirements and defaults
    
    - **Approved Milestone 2 expansion:** The user raised the active-roommate limit from 5 to 20 and requested more avatar choices. The current limit is **2–20 active roommates**, with 40 named/grouped emoji presets plus initials. PRD and DESIGN version 1.1 now reflect this explicit user-approved change from the original 2–5 limit. Existing saved avatar values and `schemaVersion: 1` remain compatible.
    - **Backend conflict resolved:** The user selected the approved local-only scope. Use Next.js App Router without backend API routes, Server Actions, authentication or a database. Household operations run in the browser.
    - **History ordering:** Preserve completion events in append order; display newest first, as DESIGN specifies.
    - **Archived-member edge cases:** Historical records remain viewable and editable without losing member references. Before reopening an expense involving archived members, require their restoration. Before reopening a chore assigned to an archived member, require reassignment to an active member. Rotation can directly select the next active member.
    - **Design contrast:** Preserve the visual palette, but use sufficiently dark text variants where muted tokens fail contrast requirements.
    - **Priority:** All PRD must-haves remain MVP requirements. Defer photo uploads and decorative animation. The user explicitly approved dependency-free chore-card dragging during UI review on 24 November 2026.

    function useSidebar() {
      const context = React.useContext(SidebarContext);
      if (!context) {
        throw new Error("useSidebar must be used within a SidebarProvider.");
      }
    
      return context;
    }
    
    function SidebarProvider({
      defaultOpen = true,
      open: openProp,
      onOpenChange: setOpenProp,
      className,
      style,
      children,
      ...props
    }: React.ComponentProps<"div"> & {
      defaultOpen?: boolean;
      open?: boolean;
      onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void;
    }) {
      const isMobile = useIsMobile();
      const [openMobile, setOpenMobile] = React.useState(false);
    
      // This is the internal state of the sidebar.
      // We use openProp and setOpenProp for control from outside the component.
      const [_open, _setOpen] = React.useState(defaultOpen);
      const open = openProp ?? _open;
      const setOpen = React.useCallback(
        (value: boolean | ((value: boolean) => boolean)) => {
          const openState = typeof value === "function" ? value(open) : value;
          if (setOpenProp) {
            setOpenProp(openState);
          } else {
            _setOpen(openState);
          }
    
          // Sidebar expansion is temporary UI state.
        },
        [setOpenProp, open],
      );
    
      // Helper to toggle the sidebar.
      const toggleSidebar = React.useCallback(() => {
        return isMobile ? setOpenMobile((open) => !open) : setOpen((open) => !open);
      }, [isMobile, setOpen, setOpenMobile]);
    
      // Adds a keyboard shortcut to toggle the sidebar.
      React.useEffect(() => {
        const handleKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
          if (
            event.key === SIDEBAR_KEYBOARD_SHORTCUT &&
            (event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey)
          ) {
            event.preventDefault();
            toggleSidebar();
          }
        };
    
        window.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
        return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
      }, [toggleSidebar]);
    
      // We add a state so that we can do data-state="expanded" or "collapsed".
      // This makes it easier to style the sidebar with Tailwind classes.
      const state = open ? "expanded" : "collapsed";
    
      const contextValue = React.useMemo<SidebarContextProps>(
        () => ({
          state,
          open,
          setOpen,
          isMobile,
          openMobile,
          setOpenMobile,
          toggleSidebar,
        }),
        [state, open, setOpen, isMobile, openMobile, setOpenMobile, toggleSidebar],
      );
    
      return (
        <SidebarContext.Provider value={contextValue}>
          <div
            data-slot="sidebar-wrapper"
            style={
              {
                "--sidebar-width": SIDEBAR_WIDTH,
                "--sidebar-width-icon": SIDEBAR_WIDTH_ICON,
                ...style,
              } as React.CSSProperties
            }
            className={cn(
              "group/sidebar-wrapper flex min-h-svh w-full has-data-[variant=inset]:bg-sidebar",
              className,
            )}
            {...props}
          >
            {children}
          </div>
        </SidebarContext.Provider>
      );
    }
    
    function Sidebar({
      side = "left",
      variant = "sidebar",
      collapsible = "offcanvas",
      className,
      children,
      dir,
    
      return (
        <div
          className="group peer hidden text-sidebar-foreground lg:block"
          data-state={state}
          data-collapsible={state === "collapsed" ? collapsible : ""}
          data-variant={variant}
          data-side={side}
          data-slot="sidebar"
        >
          {/* This is what handles the sidebar gap on desktop */}
          <div
            data-slot="sidebar-gap"
            className={cn(
              "relative w-(--sidebar-width) bg-transparent transition-[width] duration-200 ease-linear",
              "group-data-[collapsible=offcanvas]:w-0",
              "group-data-[side=right]:rotate-180",
              variant === "floating" || variant === "inset"
                ? "group-data-[collapsible=icon]:w-[calc(var(--sidebar-width-icon)+(--spacing(4)))]"
                : "group-data-[collapsible=icon]:w-(--sidebar-width-icon)",
            )}
          />
          <div
            data-slot="sidebar-container"
            data-side={side}
            className={cn(
              "fixed inset-y-0 z-10 hidden h-svh w-(--sidebar-width) transition-[left,right,width] duration-200 ease-linear data-[side=left]:left-0 data-[side=left]:group-data-[collapsible=offcanvas]:left-[calc(var(--sidebar-width)*-1)] data-[side=right]:right-0 data-[side=right]:group-data-[collapsible=offcanvas]:right-[calc(var(--sidebar-width)*-1)] lg:flex",
              // Adjust the padding for floating and inset variants.
              variant === "floating" || variant === "inset"
                ? "p-2 group-data-[collapsible=icon]:w-[calc(var(--sidebar-width-icon)+(--spacing(4))+2px)]"
                : "group-data-[collapsible=icon]:w-(--sidebar-width-icon) group-data-[side=left]:border-r group-data-[side=right]:border-l",
              className,
            )}
            {...props}
          >
            <div
              data-sidebar="sidebar"
              data-slot="sidebar-inner"
              className="flex size-full flex-col bg-sidebar group-data-[variant=floating]:rounded-lg group-data-[variant=floating]:shadow-sm group-data-[variant=floating]:ring-1 group-data-[variant=floating]:ring-sidebar-border"
            >
              {children}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      );
    }
    
    function SidebarTrigger({
      className,
      onClick,
      ...props
    }: React.ComponentProps<typeof Button>) {
      const { toggleSidebar } = useSidebar();
    
      return (
        <Button
          data-sidebar="trigger"
          data-slot="sidebar-trigger"
          variant="ghost"
          size="icon-sm"
          className={cn(className)}
          onClick={(event) => {

    ## 4. Application shell and navigation
    
    ### Desktop (>=1024 px)
    
    ```text
    ┌────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
    │ R  RoomieOS        │ Maple House / Dashboard           [Avery ▾]             │
    │                    ├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
    │ ⌂  Dashboard       │                                                          │
    │ ☑  Chores          │  🏠 Maple House                                          │
    │ ◫  Expenses        │  A calmer way to share your space.                       │
    │ ▤  Agreements      │                                                          │
    │                    │  [My chores] [My balance] [Open expenses]               │
    │                    │                                                          │
    │ ─────────────────  │  Upcoming chores                  Household snapshot      │
    │ ⚙  Settings        │  ┌─────────────────────────┐      ┌───────────────────┐   │
    │                    │  │ Clean kitchen ...       │      │ 5 pending chores  │   │
    │ Local demo         │  │ Take out trash ...      │      │ 2 open expenses   │   │
    │ Saved on browser   │  └─────────────────────────┘      └───────────────────┘   │
    └────────────────────┴──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
    ```
    
    Sidebar content order: logo, household label if useful, Dashboard, Chores, Expenses, Agreements; Settings anchored near bottom. Active page has a pale blue tint and a narrow left accent or colored text (not both aggressively). Use Lucide icons for navigation.
    
    Profile switcher lives in the top bar: avatar + name + chevron. Dropdown lists all **active** roommates and includes a small explanation `Switch demo perspective`. It must never look like secure sign-in.
    
    ### Tablet (640–1023 px)
    
    Collapse sidebar to narrow icon rail (optional) or an accessible slide-over menu. Preserve title, breadcrumbs and switcher. Content grid may become 2 columns or stacked depending on available width.
    
    ### Phone (<640 px)
    
    Prefer a top bar with compact RoomieOS mark, current roommate switcher, and accessible navigation trigger. Navigation may be a drawer or compact bottom navigation; choose whichever is easier to implement reliably. Cards stack into one column. Forms open as full-width sheets or generous dialogs. **Never let the whole page overflow horizontally.**
    
    ## When to use Server and Client Components?
    
    The client and server environments have different capabilities. Server and Client Components allow you to run logic in each environment depending on your use case.
    
    Use **Client Components** when you need:
    
    - [State](https://react.dev/learn/managing-state) and [event handlers](https://react.dev/learn/responding-to-events). E.g. `onClick`, `onChange`.
    - [Lifecycle logic](https://react.dev/learn/lifecycle-of-reactive-effects). E.g. `useEffect`.
    - Browser-only APIs. E.g. `localStorage`, `window`, `navigator.geolocation`, etc.
    - [Custom hooks](https://react.dev/learn/reusing-logic-with-custom-hooks).
    
    Use **Server Components** when you need:
    
    - Fetch data from databases or APIs close to the source.
    - Use API keys, tokens, and other secrets without exposing them to the client.
    - Reduce the amount of JavaScript sent to the browser.
    - Improve the [First Contentful Paint (FCP)](https://web.dev/fcp/), and stream content progressively to the client.
    
    For example, the `<Page>` component is a Server Component that fetches data about a post, and passes it as props to the `<LikeButton>` which handles client-side interactivity.

    ---
    title: devIndicators
    description: Configuration options for the on-screen indicator that gives context about the current route you're viewing during development.
    ---
    
    `devIndicators` allows you to configure the on-screen indicator that gives context about the current route you're viewing during development.
    
    Open `next.config.ts` and set `position` to choose where the indicator renders. The default is `bottom-left`.
    
    ```ts filename="next.config.ts"
    import type { NextConfig } from 'next'
    
    const nextConfig: NextConfig = {
      devIndicators: {
        position: 'bottom-right', // 'bottom-left' | 'bottom-right' | 'top-left' | 'top-right'
      },
    }
    
    export default nextConfig
    ```
    
    To hide the indicator entirely, set `devIndicators` to `false`. Next.js will still surface any compile or runtime errors that were encountered.
    
    ```ts filename="next.config.ts"
    const nextConfig: NextConfig = {
      devIndicators: false,
    }
    
    export default nextConfig
    ```
    
    ## Troubleshooting
    
    ### Indicator not marking a route as static
    
    If you expect a route to be static and the indicator has marked it as dynamic, it's likely the route has opted out of prerendering.
    
    You can confirm if a route is [prerendered](/docs/app/glossary#prerendering) or [dynamically rendered](/docs/app/glossary#dynamic-rendering) by building your application using `next build --debug`, and checking the output in your terminal. Static (or prerendered) routes will display a `○` symbol, whereas dynamic routes will display a `ƒ` symbol. For example:
    
    ```bash filename="Build Output"
    Route (app)
    ┌ ○ /_not-found
    └ ƒ /products/[id]
    
    ○  (Static)   prerendered as static content
    ƒ  (Dynamic)  server-rendered on demand
    ```
    
    <AppOnly>
    
    There are two reasons a route might opt out of prerendering:
    
    - The presence of [Request-time APIs](/docs/app/glossary#request-time-apis) which rely on request information.
    - An [uncached data request](/docs/app/getting-started/fetching-data), like a call to an ORM or database driver.
    
    Check your route for any of these conditions, and if you are not able to statically render the route, then consider using [`loading.js`](/docs/app/api-reference/file-conventions/loading) or [`<Suspense />`](https://react.dev/reference/react/Suspense) to leverage [streaming](/docs/app/getting-started/linking-and-navigating#streaming).
    
    </AppOnly>
    
    <PagesOnly>
    
    When exporting [`getServerSideProps`](/docs/pages/building-your-application/data-fetching/get-server-side-props) or [`getInitialProps`](/docs/pages/api-reference/functions/get-initial-props) from a page, it will be marked as dynamic.
    
    </PagesOnly>

    # RoomieOS implementation plan
    
    **Last updated:** 24 November 2026
    
    **Status:** Sidebar polish implemented and verified following component review. No deployment performed.
    
    **Current milestone:** Component review — sidebar polish complete.
    
    **Next milestone:** Milestone 6 — release verification and submission deliverables.
    
    **Delivery target:** Thursday, 26 November 2026; Friday, 27 November is the submission/fix buffer.
    
    ## 1. Purpose, authority and decisions
    
    Build a polished Next.js client-side prototype for ENTI 407. `docs/PRD.md` is authoritative for behavior; `docs/DESIGN.md` is authoritative for UI/UX. This document records approved architecture, sequencing and actual progress. It does not override those requirements.
    
    At plan approval, the repository contained documentation and a README, with no application scaffold. The foundation, household setup/persistence, chores, expenses, agreements and integrated dashboard are now implemented; see the progress record below for verification. Update this record after each working slice: check only completed work, record actual verification, and keep the current/next milestone accurate. Surface conflicts or new scope for user review rather than inventing requirements.
    
    ### Resolved requirements and defaults
    
    - **Approved Milestone 2 expansion:** The user raised the active-roommate limit from 5 to 20 and requested more avatar choices. The current limit is **2–20 active roommates**, with 40 named/grouped emoji presets plus initials. PRD and DESIGN version 1.1 now reflect this explicit user-approved change from the original 2–5 limit. Existing saved avatar values and `schemaVersion: 1` remain compatible.
    - **Backend conflict resolved:** The user selected the approved local-only scope. Use Next.js App Router without backend API routes, Server Actions, authentication or a database. Household operations run in the browser.
    - **History ordering:** Preserve completion events in append order; display newest first, as DESIGN specifies.
    - **Archived-member edge cases:** Historical records remain viewable and editable without losing member references. Before reopening an expense involving archived members, require their restoration. Before reopening a chore assigned to an archived member, require reassignment to an active member. Rotation can directly select the next active member.
    "use client";
    import { useState } from "react";
    import { CheckSquare, Plus } from "lucide-react";
    import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
    import { EmptyState } from "@/components/ui/empty-state";
    import { MemberAvatar } from "@/components/ui/member-avatar";
    import { PageHeader } from "@/components/ui/page-header";
    import { SelectField, selectOptions } from "@/components/ui/select-field";
    import { choreStatuses, choreStatusLabels } from "@/domain/chores";
    import type { Chore } from "@/domain/types";
    import { useReadyHousehold } from "@/state/household-provider";
    import { useToday } from "@/state/use-today";
    import { ChoreBoard } from "./chore-board";
    import { ChoreForm } from "./chore-form";
    import { ChoreDetails } from "./chore-details";
    
    export function ChoresScreen() {
      const { state, store, conflict } = useReadyHousehold();
      const today = useToday();
      const [status, setStatus] = useState("all");
      const [assigneeId, setAssigneeId] = useState("all");
      const [creating, setCreating] = useState(false);
      const [selectedId, setSelectedId] = useState<string | null>(null);
      const selected = state.chores.find((chore) => chore.id === selectedId);
      const chores = state.chores.filter(
        (chore) =>
          (status === "all" || chore.status === status) &&
          (assigneeId === "all" || chore.assigneeId === assigneeId),
      );
      const members = [...state.members].sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order);
      function newChore() {
        store.dismissFeedback();
        setCreating(true);
      }
      function openChore(chore: Chore) {
        store.dismissFeedback();
        setSelectedId(chore.id);
      }
      function memberLabel(chore: Chore) {
        const member = members.find((item) => item.id === chore.assigneeId)!;
        return (
          <span className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2">
            <MemberAvatar
              name={member.name}
              icon={member.avatar.kind === "icon" ? member.avatar.value : undefined}
            />
            <span className="min-w-0 break-words text-sm">
              {member.name}
              {!member.active && " (archived)"}
            </span>
          </span>
        );
      }
      return (
        <>
          <PageHeader
            title="Chores"
            description="A little clarity for the everyday things."
            icon={<CheckSquare className="size-6" />}
            action={
              <Button id="new-chore" onClick={newChore} disabled={conflict}>
                <Plus aria-hidden="true" className="size-4" />
                New chore
              </Button>
            }
          />
          <div className="mb-6 flex flex-wrap items-end gap-4">
            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 basis-40">
              <SelectField
                id="chore-status-filter"
                label="Filter by status"
                value={status}
                onValueChange={(value) => setStatus(value)}
                options={selectOptions(
                  { value: "all", label: <>All statuses</> },
                  choreStatuses.map((value) => ({
                    value: value,
                    label: <>{choreStatusLabels[value]}</>,
                  })),
                )}
              />
            </div>
            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 basis-44">
              <SelectField
                id="chore-member-filter"
                label="Filter by roommate"
                value={assigneeId}
                onValueChange={(value) => setAssigneeId(value)}
                options={selectOptions(
                  { value: "all", label: <>All roommates</> },
                  members
                    .filter(
                      (member) =>
                        member.active ||
                        state.chores.some(
                          (chore) => chore.assigneeId === member.id,
                        ),
                    )
                    .map((member) => ({
                      value: member.id,
                      label: (
                        <>
                          {member.name}
                          {!member.active && " (archived)"}
                        </>
                      ),
                    })),
                )}
              />
            </div>
          </div>
          {state.chores.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState
              icon={<CheckSquare className="size-6" />}
              title="Nothing on the chore board"
              action={
                <Button disabled={conflict} onClick={newChore}>
                  Add a chore
                </Button>
              }
            >
              <p>Add your first chore to get started.</p>
            </EmptyState>
          ) : (
            <>
              <p role="status" className="mb-4 text-sm text-muted">
                {chores.length} {chores.length === 1 ? "chore" : "chores"}
                {status !== "all" || assigneeId !== "all"
                  ? " match your filters"
                  : " in your household"}
                .
              </p>
              {chores.length === 0 ? (
                <EmptyState
                  icon={<CheckSquare className="size-6" />}
                  title="No matching chores"
                  action={
                    <Button
                      variant="secondary"
                      onClick={() => {
                        setStatus("all");
                        setAssigneeId("all");
                      }}
                    >
                      Clear filters
                    </Button>
                  }
                >
                  <p>Try a different status or roommate.</p>
                </EmptyState>
              ) : (
                <ChoreBoard
                  chores={chores}
                  today={today}
                  disabled={conflict}
                  onOpen={openChore}
                  memberLabel={memberLabel}
                  onMove={(chore, status) =>
                    store.dispatch(
                      { type: "set-chore-status", id: chore.id, status },
                      "Chore moved.",
                    )
                  }
                />
              )}
            </>
          )}
          {creating && (
            <ChoreForm chore={null} onClose={() => setCreating(false)} />
          )}
          {selected && (
            <ChoreDetails
              key={selected.id}
              chore={selected}
              today={today}
              onClose={() => setSelectedId(null)}
              onDeleted={() => {
                setSelectedId(null);
                requestAnimationFrame(() =>
                  document.getElementById("new-chore")?.focus(),
                );
              }}
            />
          )}
        </>
      );
    }

    ## When to use Server and Client Components?
    
    The client and server environments have different capabilities. Server and Client Components allow you to run logic in each environment depending on your use case.
    
    Use **Client Components** when you need:
    
    - [State](https://react.dev/learn/managing-state) and [event handlers](https://react.dev/learn/responding-to-events). E.g. `onClick`, `onChange`.
    - [Lifecycle logic](https://react.dev/learn/lifecycle-of-reactive-effects). E.g. `useEffect`.
    - Browser-only APIs. E.g. `localStorage`, `window`, `navigator.geolocation`, etc.
    - [Custom hooks](https://react.dev/learn/reusing-logic-with-custom-hooks).
    
    Use **Server Components** when you need:
    
    - Fetch data from databases or APIs close to the source.
    - Use API keys, tokens, and other secrets without exposing them to the client.
    - Reduce the amount of JavaScript sent to the browser.

    import { changeChoreStatus, expectChoreStatus } from "./ui-controls";
    import { selectItems } from "./ui-controls";
    import { getDialog, selectControl, expectControlValue } from "./ui-controls";
    import { expect, test, type Page } from "@playwright/test";
    import { createSampleHousehold } from "../../src/domain/sample";
    import { localDate, relativeDate } from "../../src/domain/dates";
    import { suggestedRotationDate } from "../../src/domain/chores";
    import type { AppState } from "../../src/domain/types";
    
    async function seed(page: Page, state = createSampleHousehold(new Date())) {
      await page.addInitScript((value) => {
        if (localStorage.getItem("roomieos:v1") === null)
          localStorage.setItem("roomieos:v1", JSON.stringify(value));
      }, state);
      await page.goto("/chores/");
      await expect(page.getByRole("heading", { level: 1 })).toHaveText("Chores");
    }
    async function saved(page: Page): Promise<AppState> {
      return page.evaluate(() => JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("roomieos:v1")!));
    }
    function titleButton(page: Page, title: string) {
      return page
        .getByRole("button", { name: title, exact: true })
        .filter({ visible: true });
    }
    async function noOverflow(page: Page) {
      expect(
        await page.evaluate(
          () =>
            document.documentElement.scrollWidth >
            document.documentElement.clientWidth,
        ),
      ).toBe(false);
    }

    test("failed storage saves retain chore drafts and history until retry succeeds", async ({
      page,
    }) => {
      await seed(page);
      await page.evaluate(() => {
        const original = Storage.prototype.setItem;
        Storage.prototype.setItem = function (key, value) {
          if (
            key === "roomieos:v1" &&
            sessionStorage.getItem("fail-chore-save") === "yes"
          )
            throw new DOMException("Storage full", "QuotaExceededError");
          return original.call(this, key, value);
        };
        sessionStorage.setItem("fail-chore-save", "yes");
      });
      const before = await saved(page);
      await page.getByRole("button", { name: "New chore", exact: true }).click();
      const form = getDialog(page, { name: "New chore", exact: true });
      await form.getByLabel("Title", { exact: false }).fill("Water the plants");
      await form.getByRole("button", { name: "Save chore", exact: true }).click();
      await expect(form.getByText(/Couldn't save changes/)).toBeVisible();
      await expectControlValue(
        form.getByLabel("Title", { exact: false }),
        "Water the plants",
      );
      expect(await saved(page)).toEqual(before);
      await page.evaluate(() => sessionStorage.removeItem("fail-chore-save"));
      await form.getByRole("button", { name: "Save chore", exact: true }).click();
      await expect(form).not.toBeVisible();
      await titleButton(page, "Water the plants").click();
      const details = getDialog(page, {
        name: "Water the plants",
        exact: true,
      });
      await page.evaluate(() => sessionStorage.setItem("fail-chore-save", "yes"));
      await details
        .getByRole("button", { name: "Mark completed", exact: true })
        .click();
      await expect(details.getByText(/Couldn't save changes/)).toBeVisible();
      await expect(details.getByText("No completions yet.")).toBeVisible();
      await page.evaluate(() => sessionStorage.removeItem("fail-chore-save"));
      await details
        .getByRole("button", { name: "Mark completed", exact: true })
        .click();
      await expect(
        details
          .getByRole("region", { name: "Completion history" })
          .getByRole("listitem"),
      ).toHaveCount(1);
      await page.evaluate(() => sessionStorage.setItem("fail-chore-save", "yes"));
      await details
        .getByRole("button", { name: "Delete chore", exact: true })
        .click();
      const confirmation = getDialog(page, {
        name: "Delete chore?",
        exact: true,
      });
      await confirmation
        .getByRole("button", { name: "Delete chore", exact: true })
        .click();
      await expect(confirmation.getByText(/Couldn't save changes/)).toBeVisible();
      expect((await saved(page)).chores.at(-1)?.completionHistory).toHaveLength(1);
      await page.evaluate(() => sessionStorage.removeItem("fail-chore-save"));
      await confirmation
        .getByRole("button", { name: "Delete chore", exact: true })
        .click();
      await expect(confirmation).not.toBeVisible();
      expect((await saved(page)).chores).toHaveLength(before.chores.length);
    });

    function RotationForm({

      onClose,

      chore: Chore;
      onClose: () => void;
    }) {
      const { state, store, conflict } = useReadyHousehold();

      const [date, setDate] = useState(() =>
        suggestedRotationDate(chore.dueDate, localDate(new Date())),
      );
      const [dateError, setDateError] = useState<string>();
      const [saveError, setSaveError] = useState<string>();
      function submit(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
        event.preventDefault();
        if (!isCalendarDate(date)) {
          setDateError("Choose a valid calendar date.");
          focusInvalid(event.currentTarget);
          return;
        }
        const result = store.dispatch(
          { type: "rotate-chore", id: chore.id, dueDate: date },
          `Chore rotated to ${next.name}.`,
        );
        if (result.ok) onClose();
        else setSaveError(result.error);
      }

          title="Rotate chore"
          onClose={onClose}

      };
      function confirm() {
        const result =

              ? store.clear()
              : confirmation
                ? store.dispatch(
                    { type: "archive-member", id: confirmation.id },

            : null;

    **Last updated:** 24 November 2026
    
    **Status:** Selected-roommate chore boards and filter removal implemented and verified. No deployment performed.
    
    **Current milestone:** Component review — selected-roommate boards complete.
    
    **Next milestone:** Milestone 6 — release verification and submission deliverables.

    ## 1. Purpose, authority and decisions
    
    Build a polished Next.js client-side prototype for ENTI 407. `docs/PRD.md` is authoritative for behavior; `docs/DESIGN.md` is authoritative for UI/UX. This document records approved architecture, sequencing and actual progress. It does not override those requirements.
    
    At plan approval, the repository contained documentation and a README, with no application scaffold. The foundation, household setup/persistence, chores, expenses, agreements and integrated dashboard are now implemented; see the progress record below for verification. Update this record after each working slice: check only completed work, record actual verification, and keep the current/next milestone accurate. Surface conflicts or new scope for user review rather than inventing requirements.
    
    ### Resolved requirements and defaults
    
    - **Approved Milestone 2 expansion:** The user raised the active-roommate limit from 5 to 20 and requested more avatar choices. The current limit is **2–20 active roommates**, with 40 named/grouped emoji presets plus initials. PRD and DESIGN version 1.1 now reflect this explicit user-approved change from the original 2–5 limit. Existing saved avatar values and `schemaVersion: 1` remain compatible.
    - **Backend conflict resolved:** The user selected the approved local-only scope. Use Next.js App Router without backend API routes, Server Actions, authentication or a database. Household operations run in the browser.
    - **History ordering:** Preserve completion events in append order; display newest first, as DESIGN specifies.
    - **Archived-member edge cases:** Historical records remain viewable and editable without losing member references. Before reopening an expense involving archived members, require their restoration. Before reopening a chore assigned to an archived member, require reassignment to an active member. Rotation can directly select the next active member.
    "use client";
    
    import { ArrowRight, Scale } from "lucide-react";
    import { MemberAvatar } from "@/components/ui/member-avatar";
    import {
      calculateBalances,
      formatMoney,
      simplifyBalances,
    } from "@/domain/money";
    import { useReadyHousehold } from "@/state/household-provider";
    
    export function ExpenseBalances() {
      const { state } = useReadyHousehold();
      const balances = calculateBalances(state.members, state.expenses);
      const net = balances.find(
        (row) => row.memberId === state.selectedMemberId,
      )!.netCents;
      const selected = state.members.find(
        (member) => member.id === state.selectedMemberId,
      )!;
      const transfers = simplifyBalances(balances);
      return (
        <div className="mb-9 grid items-start gap-4 md:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(0,2fr)]">
          <section
            className="min-w-0 rounded-[10px] border border-line p-5"
            aria-label="My net position"
          >
            <h2 className="text-sm font-medium text-muted">My net position</h2>
            <p className="mt-3 break-words text-2xl font-semibold tabular-nums">
              {formatMoney(Math.abs(net), state.household.currency)}
            </p>
            <p className="mt-2 break-words text-sm text-muted">
              {selected.name}:{" "}
              {net > 0 ? "you are owed" : net < 0 ? "you owe" : "you are even"}.
            </p>
            <p className="mt-4 text-xs leading-relaxed text-muted">
              Contributions minus shares, across open expenses only.
            </p>
          </section>
          <section
            className="min-w-0 rounded-[10px] border border-line p-5"
            aria-labelledby="transfers-heading"
          >
            <h2
              id="transfers-heading"
              className="flex items-center gap-2 text-base font-semibold"
            >
              <Scale aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 text-muted" />
              Who owes whom
            </h2>
            {transfers.length ? (
              <ul className="mt-4 divide-y divide-line">
                {transfers.map((transfer) => {
                  const from = state.members.find(
                    (member) => member.id === transfer.fromId,
                  )!;
                  const to = state.members.find(
                    (member) => member.id === transfer.toId,
                  )!;
                  return (
                    <li
                      key={`${from.id}-${to.id}`}
                      className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 py-3 first:pt-0"
                    >
                      <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2">
                        <MemberAvatar
                          name={from.name}
                          icon={
                            from.avatar.kind === "icon"
                              ? from.avatar.value
                              : undefined
                          }
                        />
                        <ArrowRight
                          aria-hidden="true"
                          className="size-4 shrink-0 text-muted"
                        />
                        <MemberAvatar
                          name={to.name}
                          icon={
                            to.avatar.kind === "icon" ? to.avatar.value : undefined
                          }
                        />
                        <p className="min-w-0 break-words text-sm">
                          {from.name} owes {to.name}
                        </p>
                      </div>
                      <span className="text-sm font-semibold tabular-nums">
                        {formatMoney(
                          transfer.amountCents,
                          state.household.currency,
                        )}
                      </span>
                    </li>
                  );
                })}
              </ul>
            ) : (
              <div className="mt-4">
                <p className="text-sm font-medium">All settled up</p>
                <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-muted">
                  No outstanding net balances. Open records may still need to be
                  marked settled.
                </p>
              </div>
            )}
            <p className="mt-4 border-t border-line pt-3 text-xs leading-relaxed text-muted">
              Suggested netting across open expenses. No payment is requested or
              made here. These suggestions do not mark individual expenses settled.
            </p>
          </section>
        </div>
      );
    }

    **Details:** primary status action, `Rotate to next`, edit, delete. History panel shows `Completed by Avery • 22 Nov` in reverse chronological order. Rotation asks for the next due date and names the next assignee before confirmation.
    
    **Status visuals:**
    - Pending = neutral gray pill.
    - Completed = gentle green pill with check icon.
    - Skipped = amber neutral pill with skip icon.
    - Overdue = small red `Overdue` label alongside **Pending** status; no red full-screen treatment.
    
    ### 5.4 Expenses
    
    Header: `Expenses` / `Track shared spending without the spreadsheet.` / `+ Add expense`.
    
    Top section: selected roommate's balance summary and a `Who owes whom` panel showing simplified transfers, each on one understandable line: `Jordan owes Avery · CAD 15.00` with avatars. If nobody owes anyone, show `All settled up`.
    
    Below: a table/list of expenses with description, category, date, paid by (multiple payer avatars supported), total and `Open / Settled` label. Details shows the breakdown and actions to edit, settle/reopen or delete.
    
    **Expense form layout:**
    1. Basics: Description, amount, date, category, notes.
    2. **Who paid?** One payer row initially; add payer; each row has roommate selector and contributed amount. Show `Allocated CAD 20.00 of CAD 45.00` and an inline discrepancy until balanced.
    3. **Who shares this expense?** Multi-select roommate chips with avatars.
    4. **Split it:** compact tabs `Equally / By % / By amount`. Show appropriate controls; user can see per-person calculated shares before saving. Guard against totals not matching.
    5. Footer: `Cancel` / `Save expense`.
    
    In details, make the formula transparent: list each payer contribution and each participant share. This prevents the simplified net balances from seeming arbitrary.
    
    **Settlement action:** `Mark as settled` with modal: `This confirms the full expense was resolved outside RoomieOS. It will no longer count toward outstanding balances.` Show `Reopen expense` for settled records. No pretend payment button.
    
    
    **FR-12 — Split methods**
    - **Equal:** divide total into integer cents between selected participants. Assign any remainder cents deterministically by stable participant order.
    - **Percentage:** user enters percentages (up to two decimals), summing to exactly 100.00%; convert to integer cents using largest-remainder allocation with a stable tie-breaker. The displayed per-person cents must total exactly the expense amount.
    - **Fixed:** user enters each participant's share in currency units to two decimal places; sum must equal total exactly.
    - If the total, participants, payers or split method changes, revalidate both payer contributions and participant shares; do not silently save an inconsistent edit.
    
    **FR-13 — Ledger and simplified balances**
    - Store money internally as **integer minor units (cents)**. No floating-point financial accumulation.
    - For each **unsettled** expense: member net = payer contributions minus participant share. Sum of nets across all members must be zero.
    - Aggregate nets over all open expenses; positive nets are creditors, negative nets are debtors. Generate a deterministic simplified list of debtor -> creditor transfers using a greedy matching algorithm (largest absolute balances first; stable roommate ID/name tie-breaker).
    - Show both **My net position** for selected roommate and **Who owes whom** for the household. A $45 expense paid by A and split equally among A/B/C gives A +$30, B -$15, C -$15 (two $15 transfers to A).
    - Simplification is advisory netting, not a payment request or guaranteed minimum number of transfers.
    
    **FR-14 — Expense settlement semantics**
    - An expense is either **Open** or **Settled**. Mark Settled requires confirmation that the full expense has been resolved outside RoomieOS.
    - Settled expenses remain listed and editable/viewable but do **not** contribute to outstanding balances. Reopening restores their effect. This is not a record of partial payments or pairwise settlements.
    - If a settlement status changes, the balances and dashboard update without refresh, and remain correct after refresh.
    ## When to use Server and Client Components?
    
    The client and server environments have different capabilities. Server and Client Components allow you to run logic in each environment depending on your use case.
    
    Use **Client Components** when you need:
    
    - [State](https://react.dev/learn/managing-state) and [event handlers](https://react.dev/learn/responding-to-events). E.g. `onClick`, `onChange`.
    - [Lifecycle logic](https://react.dev/learn/lifecycle-of-reactive-effects). E.g. `useEffect`.
    - Browser-only APIs. E.g. `localStorage`, `window`, `navigator.geolocation`, etc.
    - [Custom hooks](https://react.dev/learn/reusing-logic-with-custom-hooks).
    
    Use **Server Components** when you need:
    
    - Fetch data from databases or APIs close to the source.
    - Use API keys, tokens, and other secrets without exposing them to the client.
    - Reduce the amount of JavaScript sent to the browser.
    - Improve the [First Contentful Paint (FCP)](https://web.dev/fcp/), and stream content progressively to the client.
