    export function moneyInput(cents: number): string {
      if (!Number.isSafeInteger(cents) || cents < 0)
        throw new Error("Enter a valid amount.");
      return `${BigInt(cents) / 100n}.${String(BigInt(cents) % 100n).padStart(2, "0")}`;
    }
    export function formatMoney(
      value: number | bigint,
      currency: Currency,
    ): string {
      if (typeof value === "number" && !Number.isSafeInteger(value))
        throw new Error("Enter a valid amount.");
      const cents = BigInt(value);
      const absolute = cents < 0n ? -cents : cents;
      const parts = new Intl.NumberFormat("en", {
        style: "currency",
        currency,
        currencyDisplay: "code",
      }).formatToParts(absolute / 100n);
      return (
        (cents < 0n ? "-" : "") +
        parts
          .map((part) =>
            part.type === "fraction"
              ? String(absolute % 100n).padStart(2, "0")
              : part.value,
          )
          .join("")
      );
    }

        "use client";
        
        import { Scale } from "lucide-react";
        import { MemberAvatar } from "@/components/ui/member-avatar";
        import { calculateBalances, formatMoney, simplifyBalances, type SuggestedTransfer } from "@/domain/money";
        import { useReadyHousehold } from "@/state/household-provider";
        
        export function ExpenseBalances() {
         const {state}=useReadyHousehold();
         const balances=calculateBalances(state.members,state.expenses);
         const net=balances.find(row=>row.memberId===state.selectedMemberId)!.netCents;
         const transfers=simplifyBalances(balances);
         const personal=transfers.filter(row=>row.fromId===state.selectedMemberId||row.toId===state.selectedMemberId);
         const household=transfers.filter(row=>row.fromId!==state.selectedMemberId&&row.toId!==state.selectedMemberId);
         const names=personal.map(row=>state.members.find(member=>member.id===(net<0?row.toId:row.fromId))!.name);
         const people=new Intl.ListFormat("en",{style:"long",type:"conjunction"}).format(names);
         const amount=formatMoney(Math.abs(net),state.household.currency);
         const tone=net<0?"text-danger":net>0?"text-success":"text-muted";
         function transferRow(transfer:SuggestedTransfer){
          const from=state.members.find(member=>member.id===transfer.fromId)!;
          const to=state.members.find(member=>member.id===transfer.toId)!;
          const outgoing=from.id===state.selectedMemberId;
          const incoming=to.id===state.selectedMemberId;
          const counterpart=outgoing?to:from;
          return <li key={`${from.id}-${to.id}`} className="flex min-w-0 items-start gap-3 py-3 first:pt-0">
           <div className="flex shrink-0 -space-x-1.5"><MemberAvatar name={counterpart.name} icon={counterpart.avatar.kind==="icon"?counterpart.avatar.value:undefined}/>{!outgoing&&!incoming&&<MemberAvatar name={to.name} icon={to.avatar.kind==="icon"?to.avatar.value:undefined}/>}</div>
           <p className="min-w-0 flex-1 break-words text-sm leading-7">{outgoing?"You owe ":`${from.name} owes `}<strong className={`font-semibold tabular-nums ${outgoing?"text-danger":incoming?"text-success":"text-ink"}`}>{formatMoney(transfer.amountCents,state.household.currency)}</strong>{incoming?" to you.":` to ${to.name}.`}</p>
          </li>;
         }
         return <div className="mb-9 grid items-start gap-4 md:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(0,2fr)]">
         <section className="min-w-0 rounded-[10px] border border-line p-5" aria-label="My net position">
          <h2 className="text-sm font-medium text-muted">My net position</h2>
          <p data-net-amount className={`mt-3 break-words text-3xl font-semibold tabular-nums ${tone}`}>{formatMoney(net,state.household.currency)}</p>
          <p className="mt-3 break-words text-sm leading-relaxed text-ink">{net<0?`You owe ${amount} in total to ${people}.`:net>0?`You are owed ${amount} in total by ${people}.`:"You have no outstanding balance."}</p>
          <p className="mt-4 text-xs text-muted">Across open expenses only.</p>
         </section>
         <section className="min-w-0 rounded-[10px] border border-line p-5" aria-labelledby="transfers-heading">
          <h2 id="transfers-heading" className="flex items-center gap-2 text-base font-semibold"><Scale aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 text-muted"/>Who owes whom</h2>
          {transfers.length?<>
           {personal.length>0?<ul aria-label="Your suggested balances" className="mt-4 divide-y divide-line">{personal.map(transferRow)}</ul>:<p className="mt-3 text-sm text-muted">You have no outstanding balance in this household.</p>}
           {household.length>0&&<div className={personal.length?"mt-4 border-t border-line pt-4":"mt-4"}><h3 className="mb-3 text-xs font-medium text-muted">Other household balances</h3><ul className="divide-y divide-line">{household.map(transferRow)}</ul></div>}
          </>:<div className="mt-4"><p className="text-sm font-medium">All settled up</p><p className="mt-1 text-sm text-muted">No outstanding net balances. Open records may still need to be marked settled.</p></div>}
          <p className="mt-4 border-t border-line pt-3 text-xs leading-relaxed text-muted">Suggested amounts from open expenses. Settle up outside RoomieOS, then mark each fully resolved expense as settled.</p>
         </section>
         </div>;
        }

    "use client";
    
    import { Scale } from "lucide-react";
    import { MemberAvatar } from "@/components/ui/member-avatar";
    import {
      calculateBalances,
      formatMoney,
      simplifyBalances,
      type SuggestedTransfer,
    } from "@/domain/money";
    import { useReadyHousehold } from "@/state/household-provider";
    
    export function ExpenseBalances() {
      const { state } = useReadyHousehold();
      const balances = calculateBalances(state.members, state.expenses);
      const net = balances.find(
        (row) => row.memberId === state.selectedMemberId,
      )!.netCents;
      const transfers = simplifyBalances(balances);
      const personal = transfers.filter(
        (row) =>
          row.fromId === state.selectedMemberId ||
          row.toId === state.selectedMemberId,
      );
      const household = transfers.filter(
        (row) =>
          row.fromId !== state.selectedMemberId &&
          row.toId !== state.selectedMemberId,
      );
      const names = personal.map(
        (row) =>
          state.members.find(
            (member) => member.id === (net < 0 ? row.toId : row.fromId),
          )!.name,
      );
      const people = new Intl.ListFormat("en", {
        style: "long",
        type: "conjunction",
      }).format(names);
      const amount = formatMoney(Math.abs(net), state.household.currency);
      const tone =
        net < 0 ? "text-danger" : net > 0 ? "text-success" : "text-muted";
      function transferRow(transfer: SuggestedTransfer) {
        const from = state.members.find((member) => member.id === transfer.fromId)!;
        const to = state.members.find((member) => member.id === transfer.toId)!;
        const outgoing = from.id === state.selectedMemberId;
        const incoming = to.id === state.selectedMemberId;
        const counterpart = outgoing ? to : from;
        return (
          <li
            key={`${from.id}-${to.id}`}
            className="flex min-w-0 items-start gap-3 py-3 first:pt-0"
          >
            <div className="flex shrink-0 -space-x-1.5">
              <MemberAvatar
                name={counterpart.name}
                icon={
                  counterpart.avatar.kind === "icon"
                    ? counterpart.avatar.value
                    : undefined
                }
              />
              {!outgoing && !incoming && (
                <MemberAvatar
                  name={to.name}
                  icon={to.avatar.kind === "icon" ? to.avatar.value : undefined}
                />
              )}
            </div>
            <p className="min-w-0 flex-1 break-words text-sm leading-7">
              {outgoing
                ? "You owe "
                : incoming
                  ? `${from.name} owes you `
                  : `${from.name} owes `}
              <strong
                className={`font-semibold tabular-nums ${outgoing ? "text-danger" : incoming ? "text-success" : "text-ink"}`}
              >
                {formatMoney(transfer.amountCents, state.household.currency)}
              </strong>
              {incoming ? "." : ` to ${to.name}.`}
            </p>
          </li>
        );
      }
      return (
        <div className="mb-9 grid items-start gap-4 md:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(0,2fr)]">
          <section
            className="min-w-0 rounded-[10px] border border-line p-5"
            aria-label="My net position"
          >
            <h2 className="text-sm font-medium text-muted">My net position</h2>
            <p
              data-net-amount
              className={`mt-3 break-words text-3xl font-semibold tabular-nums ${tone}`}
            >
              {formatMoney(net, state.household.currency)}
            </p>
            <p className="mt-3 break-words text-sm leading-relaxed text-ink">
              {net < 0
                ? `You owe ${amount} in total to ${people}.`
                : net > 0
                  ? `You are owed ${amount} in total by ${people}.`
                  : "You have no outstanding balance."}
            </p>
            <p className="mt-4 text-xs text-muted">Across open expenses only.</p>
          </section>
          <section
            className="min-w-0 rounded-[10px] border border-line p-5"
            aria-labelledby="transfers-heading"
          >
            <h2
              id="transfers-heading"
              className="flex items-center gap-2 text-base font-semibold"
            >
              <Scale aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 text-muted" />
              Who owes whom
            </h2>
            {transfers.length ? (
              <>
                {personal.length > 0 ? (
                  <ul
                    aria-label="Your suggested balances"
                    className="mt-4 divide-y divide-line"
                  >
                    {personal.map(transferRow)}
                  </ul>
                ) : (
                  <p className="mt-3 text-sm text-muted">
                    You have no outstanding balance in this household.
                  </p>
                )}
                {household.length > 0 && (
                  <div
                    className={
                      personal.length ? "mt-4 border-t border-line pt-4" : "mt-4"
                    }
                  >
                    <h3 className="mb-3 text-xs font-medium text-muted">
                      Other household balances
                    </h3>
                    <ul className="divide-y divide-line">
                      {household.map(transferRow)}
                    </ul>
                  </div>
                )}
              </>
            ) : (
              <div className="mt-4">
                <p className="text-sm font-medium">All settled up</p>
                <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-muted">
                  No outstanding net balances. Open records may still need to be
                  marked settled.
                </p>
              </div>
            )}
            <p className="mt-4 border-t border-line pt-3 text-xs leading-relaxed text-muted">
              Suggested amounts from open expenses. Settle up outside RoomieOS, then
              mark each fully resolved expense as settled.
            </p>
          </section>
        </div>
      );
    }

    ## When to use Server and Client Components?
    
    The client and server environments have different capabilities. Server and Client Components allow you to run logic in each environment depending on your use case.
    
    Use **Client Components** when you need:
    
    - [State](https://react.dev/learn/managing-state) and [event handlers](https://react.dev/learn/responding-to-events). E.g. `onClick`, `onChange`.
    - [Lifecycle logic](https://react.dev/learn/lifecycle-of-reactive-effects). E.g. `useEffect`.
    - Browser-only APIs. E.g. `localStorage`, `window`, `navigator.geolocation`, etc.
    - [Custom hooks](https://react.dev/learn/reusing-logic-with-custom-hooks).
    
    Use **Server Components** when you need:
